description: Display sorted concatenation of all FILE(s). With no FILE, or when FILE is -, read standard input.

option.name: --batch-size
tip: Merge at most N_MERGE inputs at once

option.name: --buffer-size
tip: sets the maximum SIZE of each segment in number of sorted items

option.name: --check
tip: check for sorted input; do not sort

option.name: --check-silent
tip: exit successfully if the given file is already sorted, and exit with status 1 otherwise

option.name: --compress-program
tip: compress temporary files with PROG, decompress with PROG -d; PROG has to take input from stdin and output to stdout

option.name: --debug
tip: underline the parts of the line that are actually used for sorting

option.name: --dictionary-order
tip: consider only blanks and alphanumeric characters

option.name: --field-separator
tip: custom separator for -k

option.name: --files0-from
tip: read input from the files specified by NUL-terminated NUL_FILE

option.name: --general-numeric-sort
tip: compare according to string general numerical value

option.name: --human-numeric-sort
tip: compare according to human readable sizes, eg 1M > 100k

option.name: --ignore-case
tip: fold lower case to upper case characters

option.name: --ignore-leading-blanks
tip: ignore leading blanks when finding sort keys in each line

option.name: --ignore-nonprinting
tip: ignore nonprinting characters

option.name: --key
tip: sort by a key

option.name: --merge
tip: merge already sorted files; do not sort

option.name: --month-sort
tip: compare according to month name abbreviation

option.name: --numeric-sort
tip: compare according to string numerical value

option.name: --output
tip: write output to FILENAME instead of stdout

option.name: --parallel
tip: change the number of threads running concurrently to NUM_THREADS

option.name: --random-sort
tip: shuffle in random order

option.name: --random-source
tip: use FILE as a source of random data

option.name: --reverse
tip: reverse the output

option.name: --sort
tip: Set the sort mode

option.name: --stable
tip: stabilize sort by disabling last-resort comparison

option.name: --temporary-directory
tip: use DIR for temporaries, not $TMPDIR or /tmp

option.name: --unique
tip: output only the first of an equal run

option.name: --version
tip: Print version information

option.name: --version-sort
tip: Sort by SemVer version number, eg 1.12.2 > 1.1.2

option.name: --zero-terminated
tip: line delimiter is NUL, not newline

global_option.name: --help
tip: Print help information
